correctness.rationale: All dimensions r,c>=1 and iid atomless score assumptions are explicit. Uniform-score reduction, external-cell factors and squared cross-cell minima yield P(M subset S)=1/(r+c-1)_{falling k} for every prescribed nonattacking k-set. Ordered matching enumeration gives every factorial moment, and uniqueness of a finite-support generating polynomial proves the hypergeometric law. Row-column group transitivity proves conditional matching uniformity. Degenerate r=1/c=1 and r=c=1 boundaries are handled. The exact-rational verifier exhaustively checks eight small boards and is not used as a substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The object is the natural set of all strict mutual row-column optima of iid scores, equivalently the pure equilibria of a two-person common-payoff random potential game. A full finite-sample count and conditional spatial matching law quantify equilibrium multiplicity and geometry in every rectangular dimension, beyond previously published mean/variance/normal approximations. The result supplies exact probabilities rather than an arbitrary slice, and assumes no unsupported algorithmic or dynamic consequences.
